title: Banks Act Circular C2/2020 — Classification of the Land and Agricultural Development Bank of South Africa (Land Bank) bills under the liquidity coverage ratio framework
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: 1.1 This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). 1.2 Classification of the Land and Agricultural Development Bank of South Africa (Land Bank) bills under the liquidity coverage ratio framework. 1.3 This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.

subsections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990).
Classification of the Land and Agricultural Development Bank of South Africa (Land Bank) bills under the liquidity coverage ratio framework.
This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.

Available online at Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio framework

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: 2.1 This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). 2.2 Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein.

sections.heading: Acknowledgement of receipt
sections.text: 3.1 Kindly ensure that a copy of this circular is made available to your institution's auditors. The attached acknowledgement of receipt, duly completed and signed by both the Chief Executive Officer of the institution and the said auditors, must be returned to the PA at the earliest convenience of the aforementioned signatories.
